name: Pattaya Marriott Resort and Spa
short_description: Marriott Hotels' family-focused beachfront resort on Jomtien Beach, Pattaya, opened 2025 with 289 rooms, three pools with water slides and a kids' club steps from the sand.
ai_summary: Pattaya Marriott Resort and Spa is a 289-room beachfront resort that opened in July 2025 in Na Jomtien, at the quieter southern end of Pattaya and directly across the road from Jomtien Beach. Developed by Asset World Corporation under the Marriott Hotels banner, it is billed as the first premium international brand on this stretch of coast, with sugar-palm-inspired architecture and Gulf of Thailand views. Independent write-ups and early guest feedback consistently praise its strong family credentials: three outdoor pools including a dedicated children's pool, water slides and an infinity pool, plus a supervised kids' club, a 24-hour fitness centre and Quan Spa. Dining spans six venues, with the all-day Goji Kitchen Grill & Bar and the Italian trattoria La Familiare drawing particular mention, and breakfast is repeatedly called out as excellent. Rooms read as modern and spacious, with private balconies and spa-style rain-shower bathrooms, and family rooms with bunk beds are a hit with children. Service earns warm reviews for attentive, efficient check-in and helpful staff. The main honest watch-out is location: Na Jomtien is roughly 10 to 12 km from central Pattaya's Beach Road nightlife and shopping, so it suits families and couples seeking a calmer base more than those wanting walkable nightlife. As a very new property its long-term consistency is still unproven and genuine long-form independent reviews remain limited, though Booking.com and Marriott guest scores are strong.

faqs.question: Where is Pattaya Marriott Resort and Spa located?
faqs.answer: The resort sits at 64 Moo 1 in Na Jomtien, Sattahip District, directly across the road from Jomtien Beach at the quieter southern end of Pattaya. Central Pattaya and Central Festival are roughly 12 km north, while U-Tapao airport is about 22 km south.

faqs.question: Is Pattaya Marriott Resort and Spa good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. It was designed around families, with three outdoor pools including a children's pool and water slides, an infinity pool, a supervised kids' club with games and crafts, and family rooms featuring bunk beds. Six dining venues and a well-praised breakfast round out the family-friendly appeal.

faqs.question: When did Pattaya Marriott Resort and Spa open?
faqs.answer: The resort opened in July 2025, developed by Asset World Corporation under the Marriott Hotels brand. It is a new-build, 289-room beachfront property described as the first premium international hotel brand on Jomtien Beach, so its facilities are modern but its long-term track record is still short.
